items.description: Proxy ID in traversal order; enabled chains require enabled proxies.

dropped_log_max_bytes.description: Maximum dropped-connection history size; defaults to 10485760.

listen.description: Loopback host:port, e.g. 127.0.0.1:18080; changing this moves the control listener.

action.description: Defaults to direct; proxy/chain require the corresponding profile ID.

applications.description: Semicolon/comma/newline alternatives: executable name, Windows path, * or ? wildcard, numeric PID, Any. Quote paths containing separators. Empty means Any.

chain_id.description: Required for action=chain; enabled rules require an enabled chain. Cleared for other actions.

enabled.description: Disabled rules do not route traffic; omitted means false.

id.description: Stable unique rule ID; required for targeted edits.

notes.description: Freeform notes; include existing notes when replacing a rule.

proxy_id.description: Required for action=proxy; enabled rules require an enabled profile. Cleared for other actions.

target_hosts.description: Alternatives: hostname, * or ? hostname glob, IP, CIDR, IP range, IP glob, localhost, %ComputerName%, Any. Empty means Any.

target_ports.description: Alternatives: TCP port 1..65535, inclusive range such as 80-443, or Any. Empty means Any.

updated_at.description: Opaque optimistic revision from config get, preserved when applying edits. Apply rejects zero or missing revision.

discovery_order: existing configuration http.listen (read-only path resolution; PITCHPROX_CONFIG/MYPROX_CONFIG supported)
http://127.0.0.1:18080 if no config file exists
encoding: JSON is UTF-8 (an optional UTF-8 BOM is accepted). Windows PowerShell 5.1 > redirection writes UTF-16; configure [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false) and pipe to Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 instead. Preserve updated_at while editing the exported file.
error_shape: stderr: {error:{code,message,current_updated_at?}}; stdout is empty on command failure
examples: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); pitchProx ctl config get | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 config.json
pitchProx ctl rules upsert --file rule.json --if-revision 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --before default

exit_codes.8: mutation outcome unknown; inspect live configuration before retrying

mutation_semantics.ambiguous_write: Exit 8 means outcome_unknown. Run config get and compare the actual fields/revision; do not automatically repeat the mutation.
mutation_semantics.disruption: Preview returns plan.mode, runtime_restart, http_rebind, connections_preserved, listening_address, reasons. Runtime restart closes intercepted connections and requires --allow-disruptive; ordinary hot reload affects new connections.
mutation_semantics.http_rebind: Use plan.listening_address/config.http.listen as the origin for subsequent requests after changing the listener.
mutation_semantics.new_rule_position: Without an explicit position, insert as the first rule when the list is empty, or before the final enabled rule with ID default and unconditional application/host/port conditions. Otherwise require --before or --after. Explicit anchors must exist even when the list is empty.
mutation_semantics.result: {config,plan,applied,previous_updated_at}; a no-op can return applied=false without advancing revision.
mutation_semantics.revision: Use config.updated_at or rules list.updated_at unchanged. Conflicts never retry or merge automatically, and --allow-disruptive never bypasses revision checks.
mutation_semantics.upsert: File is a complete rule replacement, including enabled/action/notes. An existing rule stays in position unless --before or --after is supplied.
